name: simulated-cursor
title: Simulated Cursor
description: A synthetic mouse cursor that travels between waypoints and fires a click ripple, for narrating a UI on screen.
useWhen: You are narrating a screen demo and need a synthetic cursor that moves predictably over a UI screenshot or recording.
You want to direct attention to a specific element by having the cursor travel to it and click.
avoidWhen: You need a real screen recording: this draws a synthetic overlay, not a capture.
The video is abstract or non-UI: a floating arrow reads as a tutorial and breaks the mood.
The underlying layout shifts between scenes: waypoints are absolute reference pixels.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Waypoints
variables.description: JSON array of {x, y, hold, click} in the reference frame (1280×720 by default): x and y are where the cursor rests, hold is frames to rest there, click fires a ripple on arrival.

variables.label: Frame width
variables.description: Width of the reference frame the waypoints live in; it is scaled to fit.

variables.label: Frame height
variables.description: Height of the reference frame the waypoints live in.
